annotations.text: Round 3 of the 2026-09-18 brief, drawn on the owner's read of round 2 ("still not thinking big enough; the whole thing, top-down, needs complete rethinking"). The cover puts the entire current app on one sheet and names the test — name the physical thing the app is. The three boards beside it are three whole products on one idea each: the day, the boat, the sea. Same shop, same morning, same six screens. One call, H-88; recommended I · Tide.
